subfields.name: Foundations
subfields.description: Shared prerequisite concepts that every quantum career path builds on.

subfields.name: Quantum Error Correction
subfields.description: Protecting quantum information from noise using codes, decoders and fault-tolerant schemes.

subfields.name: Hardware & Devices
subfields.description: Building qubits and machines: superconducting circuits, trapped ions, neutral atoms, photonics, control electronics and cryogenics.

subfields.name: Software & Compilers
subfields.description: Turning algorithms into runnable circuits: SDKs, compilers, transpilation, error mitigation and hybrid workflows.

subfields.name: Algorithms & Applications
subfields.description: Designing and analyzing quantum algorithms for simulation, optimization, chemistry and resource estimation.

subfields.name: Quantum Machine Learning
subfields.description: Combining quantum circuits with machine learning: variational models, kernels, data encoding and training dynamics.

subfields.name: Cryptography & Networking
subfields.description: Post-quantum cryptography, quantum key distribution and the quantum internet.

concepts.name: Linear algebra for quantum
concepts.description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues and tensor products as the math language of quantum states.

concepts.name: Qubits, gates, circuits
concepts.description: The qubit, single- and two-qubit gates, and circuits as the unit of quantum computation.

concepts.name: Measurement & probabilities
concepts.description: Born rule, measurement outcomes and reading shot data as probability distributions.

concepts.name: Entanglement
concepts.description: Correlations between qubits that have no classical explanation, and why they are a resource.

concepts.name: Stabilizer codes
concepts.description: Encoding logical qubits in the shared stabilizer group of many physical qubits (e.g. the Steane code).

concepts.name: Logical vs physical qubits & thresholds
concepts.description: Physical qubits versus error-corrected logical qubits, and the error-rate threshold theorem.

concepts.name: Surface code
concepts.description: The leading 2D stabilizer code: lattice layout, syndrome extraction and its high threshold.

concepts.name: Decoders & syndrome decoding
concepts.description: Recovering the most likely error from measurement syndromes (matching, union-find, belief propagation).

concepts.name: Magic states & fault-tolerant gates
concepts.description: Non-Clifford resources and distillation needed to run universal gates fault-tolerantly.

concepts.name: Superconducting qubits
concepts.description: Transmon qubits, circuit QED and microwave resonators — the leading industrial platform.

concepts.name: Neutral-atom arrays
concepts.description: Rydberg tweezers arranging atoms into reconfigurable qubit arrays.

concepts.name: Trapped ions
concepts.description: Individual ions as qubits controlled with lasers, with long coherence and all-to-all coupling.

concepts.name: Photonic quantum computing
concepts.description: Qubits encoded in photons: sources, interferometers and measurement-based computation.

concepts.name: Control & readout
concepts.description: Pulse control, qubit state readout and the feedback electronics around a quantum processor.

concepts.name: Circuit model & compilation basics
concepts.description: How algorithms become gate circuits and what a compiler must preserve.

concepts.name: Transpilation & routing
concepts.description: Mapping abstract circuits onto hardware couplings via gate decomposition and qubit routing.

concepts.name: Quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane)
concepts.description: Building, simulating and submitting circuits with the mainstream software stacks.

concepts.name: Error mitigation
concepts.description: Reducing noise effects without full correction: zero-noise extrapolation, probabilistic error cancellation.

concepts.name: Hybrid quantum-classical workflows
concepts.description: Orchestrating loops where a classical optimizer drives quantum circuit parameters.

concepts.name: Grover search
concepts.description: Quadratic speedup for unstructured search and its role as a subroutine.

concepts.name: Phase estimation & Shor
concepts.description: Eigenvalue estimation and the factoring algorithm that motivates the quantum threat.

concepts.name: VQE & QAOA
concepts.description: Parameterized circuits optimized by a classical loop for chemistry and optimization problems.

concepts.name: Quantum simulation
concepts.description: Simulating molecules and many-body systems, the most cited near-term application.

concepts.name: Resource estimation
concepts.description: Counting the qubits and time a cryptographically relevant or useful computation needs.

concepts.name: Variational circuits for ML
concepts.description: Parameterized quantum circuits used as model components in machine learning.

concepts.name: Quantum kernels
concepts.description: Using quantum states to define feature-space similarities for kernel methods.

concepts.name: Data encoding
concepts.description: Map classical data into quantum states: amplitude, angle and basis encoding trade-offs.

concepts.name: Barren plateaus
concepts.description: Why gradients of random parameterized circuits can vanish exponentially with system size.

concepts.name: Hybrid training loops
concepts.description: Backpropagating through quantum-classical models with parameter-shift rules and optimizers.

concepts.name: Quantum key distribution
concepts.description: Provably secure key exchange from quantum measurement disturbance (BB84 and friends).

concepts.name: Quantum threat model (Shor's impact)
concepts.description: Which public-key cryptography breaks under a large fault-tolerant quantum computer.

concepts.name: Post-quantum cryptography
concepts.description: Lattice-, hash- and code-based standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) resistant to quantum attack.

concepts.name: Entanglement distribution
concepts.description: Sharing entangled pairs over distance through fiber, satellites and heralding.

concepts.name: Quantum repeaters
concepts.description: Entanglement swapping and error correction to extend quantum links beyond direct fiber reach.
